say:1:1630321101:1.text: Oh, these? A certain clumsy mage may or may not have "accidentally" left them behind...
say:1:1630321101:1.source_cn: 啊，说到这个，当然是这里的魔法师不慎“遗落”的了。
say:1:1630321101:1.male: Oh, these? A certain clumsy mage may or may not have "accidentally" left them behind...
say:1:1630321101:1.female: Oh, these? A certain clumsy mage may or may not have "accidentally" left them behind...

say:2:1630321102:1.text: Speaking of which... I have a few rare trinkets. Not for sale to just anyone.
say:2:1630321102:1.source_cn: 说到魔法，我手里还有几个宝贝，一般我都不卖的。
say:2:1630321102:1.male: Speaking of which... I have a few rare trinkets. Not for sale to just anyone.
say:2:1630321102:1.female: Speaking of which... I have a few rare trinkets. Not for sale to just anyone.

say:3:1630321103:1.text: But you? You seem special. I'll give you a friendly discount—twenty pine cones, final offer!
say:3:1630321103:1.source_cn: 你的问题很独特，我跟你有缘，就算你便宜些——二十颗松果...
